title: Governance Event (arifOS) — baseline unit tests
description: AUTHORITATIVE machine-checked event contract for ARIFOS::BASELINE_UNIT_TESTS::v1. Verdict text MUST NEVER establish identity. Signature validity MUST NEVER establish authority by itself. Transport success MUST NEVER mean governance success. VERDICT VALUES ARE FROZEN FROM LIVE SOURCE (arifosmcp/models/verdicts.py::SealType), NOT INVENTED.

actor_key_id.description: Referenced key in registry, UNTRUSTED unless signed

actor_verified.description: CANONICAL field (abi/verification_envelope.py:268, bool default False). Derived from cryptographic envelope, NOT from verdict text. NOTE (gap-1): no Ed25519 signature verification exists in this envelope in the current source — the field is a declared bool, not a crypto-derived value.

identity_evidence.description: Envelope or absent. UNTRUSTED if signature fails.

verification_reason.description: Failure cause. Canonical reason codes only (see ReasonCode enum below).

authority_present.description: UNTRUSTED if derived from verdict text or prefix

authority_ceiling.description: Canonical field. NOT derived from verdict prefix.

verdict.description: FROZEN FROM LIVE SOURCE SealType (7 members): VOID, HOLD_888, HOLD, SABAR, PARTIAL, PROVISIONAL, SEAL. null = undetermined/missing (missing evidence must remain UNKNOWN or absent — represented as null, NOT as a fake 'UNKNOWN' verdict string). VOCABULARY CONFLICT DOCUMENTED (see EVENT_CONTRACT.md §conflict): AGENTS.md names only 4 'constitutional verdicts' (SEAL/HOLD/VOID/SABAR); the runtime SealType enum proves 7. Conflict is shown, not silently resolved.

reason_code.description: Canonical ReasonCode enum (abi/verification_envelope.py): DEPLOYED_COMMIT_MISMATCH, STATE_MISMATCH, EVIDENCE_MISSING, AUTHORITY_MISSING, DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, EVIDENCE_CONFLICT, AUTOMATED_POLICY_FAIL, AUTOMATED_EVIDENCE_FAIL, HUMAN_JUDGMENT_REQUIRED, SYSTEM_FAULT, VERIFIER_IDENTITY_VIOLATION, FRESHNESS_EXCEEDED, SUCCESS_CRITERIA_UNDEFINED. Do not invent.

can_claim_success.description: CANONICAL field (contradiction_detector.py, tools.py, verbosity.py). Separate from ok/success. MUST be false when verdict is HOLD/VOID/SABAR.

judge_source.description: Module name. 666 (judgment) vs 888 (decision) both exist; do not over-claim 888.

mutation_occurred.description: FALSE in all baseline tests — this is the gate

witness_source.description: Module name. FRAMElock per federation witness.

observed_at.description: Timestamp. DO NOT assert on this.

event_id.description: Stable identifier. CANONICAL if used. If no stable event identity exists, record that as baseline failure — do NOT manufacture one.
